environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to the service on port 3000. PostgreSQL RDS instance in same VPC with no query-level firewall. JWT validation is handled by a custom guard that extracts user.sub from the token. No WAF or API Gateway in front of the ALB. CloudFront distribution exists but only for S3 document delivery, not for the GraphQL API endpoint.

config.network: ALB -> ECS port 3000, no WAF attached
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14, no pgAudit, no query restrictions
config.cdn: CloudFront only on S3 bucket for document files, not on API
